application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
REAR GARDEN			

T1	False Acacia (Robinia pseudoacacia)	Reduce height by 0.5-1m below previous reduction points to alleviate excessive lever/pressure on the decay at the base of the tree. Reduce sides by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points. Final height = 8m and final spread = 4m.

FRONT GARDEN			

T2	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Carry out climbing inspection of the crown and provide a verbal condition report. Remove major deadwood. Final height & spread = unchanged.
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
